name: P33 - Patrol Boat
description: Former patrol boat of the Armed Forces of Malta, 23 m long, built in East Germany in 1971–72. Scuttled in July 2021 between the two tug wrecks at Marsaskala, but it is breaking up quickly on the seabed.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites. Position approximate (between the tugs).
